reuse.why: Extracts the unlink field reset from unlinkAccount into clearBankLink and uses it for both the existing unlink action and the takeover, and adds the flag to the shared LinkAccountBaseParams/linkBankSyncAccount path used by every provider.

duplication.why: The unlink state is defined once, but the 'if (alreadyLinked) await clearBankLink(...)' block is repeated in both the upgrade and new-account branches instead of once after validation.

placement.why: The takeover lives in linkBankSyncAccount, the common link routine where the uniqueness check already is, after the closed-account and missing-account guards.

scope.why: Only the flag, the takeover, the helper extraction and focused tests are added.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow and keeps unlink semantics in one helper; the duplicated branch-level call is a small wart.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated clearBankLink call in the two branches of linkBankSyncAccount is a plain, undisguised repetition.
